title: Route nested review results and stop completed owner loops

rubric.text: Includes the Claude Code foreground rule when nested results are needed and ends the brief with "after returning your report, stop; do not wait on background work"; does not over-apply it to top-level owners.

Relays actual head/coverage to the retained owner; a stale review cannot pass current-head acceptance. Stops a pushed, looping active turn via runtime cancellation without discarding checkpoint/handle or polling background work.
